verdict.rationale: Direct probes for an OpenAPI/swagger spec and llms.txt on Intuit's developer site all returned 404, indicating no publicly downloadable OpenAPI document. However, Intuit does provide machine-readable API descriptions indirectly via official SDKs (Node/PHP) and a documented MCP server with '145 total tools' covering the full QBO API, which functions as an equivalent machine-readable interface description for AI agents. Missing for 10: an actual downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger JSON/YAML file, official confirmation of spec format/versioning, and independent corroboration that the MCP tool schema is treated as a full API spec substitute.
